newsitem.title: USA: Sudbury rejects Park-Ohio purchase offer.
newsitem.headline: Sudbury rejects Park-Ohio purchase offer.

text.p: Sudbury Inc said Monday its board of directors had rejected as inadequate an unsolicited offer from Park-Ohio Industries Inc to buy the company for $170 million.
Sudbury said it would continue to explore ways to maximize shareholder value. Since July, Alex Brown & Sons Inc has been looking for contracts with entities interested in buying the company.
Nasdaq trading in Sudbury stock was halted at $12 3/4 Monday.
Park-Ohio shares were up 1/4 at 14-7/8 early Monday afternoon.
Park-Ohio last week proposed to buy the company for $170 million, or $11 a share.
Sudbury provides iron, aluminum and zinc castings and other metal products for appliance and automobile manufacturers, among others.
